name: vtbl
meaning: 0x5743a0, single entry = PolyBatcher_ScalarDeletingDtor 0x418aa0

name: renderer
meaning: the renderer/device wrapper whose IDirect3DDevice7* lives at +0x28; the batcher reaches D3D only through it

name: defaultStateFlags
meaning: RenderStateFlags applied by Render_BeginFrame at the start of every frame; initialised to 0x120 = RSF_DITHER | RSF_COLORVERTEX

name: clearColor
meaning: colour passed to IDirect3DDevice7::Clear each frame; 0 at construction, set per level by Load_DAVnWAR through 0x416f00

name: batchCapacity
meaning: triangles per batch before flush

name: textures
meaning: malloc'd array of textureCount+4 Texture object pointers, one per VDX7 page

name: texturePageCount
meaning: total texture-page count. PolyBatcher_LoadTexturePages 0x416fe2 writes it as header_word & 0xffff and then sizes BOTH the texture-object array at +0x14 and the per-texture state flags at +0x28 as count*4 + 0x10. Distinct from the immediate-page count at +0x1c.

name: immediateTexCount
meaning: count of the IMMEDIATE texture prefix, a subset of texturePageCount at +0x18 (not a total).

name: lastTextureIndex
meaning: index of the texture currently bound to stage 0, used to skip redundant SetTexture calls

name: textureDirty
meaning: forces the next textured draw to rebind even if the index matches; set by Render_BeginFrame, by the untextured batch flush and after each line or deferred untextured draw, cleared on bind

name: texStateFlags
meaning: per-page RenderStateFlags: 0xc020 for immediate pages (TEXTURED|FILTER_LINEAR|DITHER), 0xc002 for alpha-blend pages, 0xc004 for additive pages

name: flatBatchVerts
meaning: untextured triangle batch, capacity * 0x48 bytes (3 vertices of 0x18, FVF 0xc4).

name: flatBatchCount
meaning: triangles in the untextured batch

name: stateFlags
meaning: the RenderStateFlags word applied when the untextured batch is flushed

name: texBatchVerts
meaning: per-texture batch buffers (0x60 per triangle, FVF 0x1c4); counts at +0x3C[], render flags at +0x28[], texture objects at +0x14[]

name: texBatchCounts
meaning: per-texture triangle counts, one per immediate page, parallel to texBatchVerts (+0x38) and texStateFlags (+0x28); PolyBatcher_SubmitPoly indexes it with the page number and LightSpot::Render does the same in its inlined copy (0x4f7f27 add ecx,edx before the count compare)

name: computeSortZ
meaning: 1 makes PolyBatcher_SubmitPoly compute a deferred poly's sortZ as the sum of its three vertex z (read at 0x52f7e7 in the inlined submit of Weather_DrawRain, written by PolyBatcher_SetComputeSortZ 0x416f16)

name: sortedPolys
meaning: pool of 6000 RenderPoly of 0x20 bytes; the allocation is 0x2ee04 bytes = a leading count word (6000) plus the array, and the field points past the count

name: sortedList
meaning: malloc(24000) = 6000 pointers into the RenderPoly pool; this is the array qsort reorders

name: sortedCount
meaning: number of RenderPoly already pushed into sortedList this frame; the index RenderPoly_Assign writes at and the counter it bumps (0x4f7d3a imul eax,eax,0x20 on +0x44, then mov [ecx+0x4c],eax)

name: blendStateFlags
meaning: RenderStateFlags for RenderPoly type 2, initialised to 2 = RSF_BLEND_ALPHA (SRCBLEND=INVSRCALPHA, DESTBLEND=SRCALPHA - the inverted-alpha convention)

name: addStateFlags
meaning: RenderStateFlags for RenderPoly type 3, initialised to 4 = RSF_BLEND_ADD (SRCBLEND=INVSRCALPHA, DESTBLEND=ONE)

name: lineBatchVerts
meaning: line batch: a fixed 96000-byte buffer = 4000 vertices of 0x18 bytes = 2000 lines, drawn as D3DPT_LINELIST

name: lineBatchCount
meaning: lines queued in the line batch; zeroed by the flush and by the discard path of Render_EndFrame

name: lineStateFlags
meaning: RenderStateFlags for the line batch, 0x121 = RSF_ANTIALIAS | RSF_DITHER | RSF_COLORVERTEX
